name: foundry-governance
description: Microsoft Foundry enterprise governance documentation and presentation

scripts.build: npm run build:docs && npm run build:presentation
scripts.stage:docs: rm -rf _docs && mkdir _docs && cp README.md CONTRIBUTING.md LICENSE _docs/ && cp -R docs architecture governance checklists templates examples references _docs/ && mkdir -p _docs/assets/javascripts && cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js _docs/assets/javascripts/mermaid.min.js
scripts.build:docs: npm run stage:docs && python -m mkdocs build --strict
